args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: large square4096x4096 transparent sprite atlas, EXACTLY16 columns by16 rows, 256 separate sequential frames. Each cell is identical size. No labels, dividers or grid lines.
References1/2: original Victamin design authority. The SAME tiny pet throughout: exactly two tall oval rabbit ears, screen-left inner orange/right inner yellow; limbless cream/white rectangular layered-paper pompom body; two orange square cheeks; small dark eyes and U smile. No arms, legs, hands, feet, hat, props, symbols, text, action strokes, glitter, ground shadows or background. Clean matte cel illustration; broad readable paper-tab groups, medium warm taupe outline, sparse interior seams, soft butter/apricot highlights. No pixel dithering, fine scratchy lines or noise.
Maintain the SAME layer arrangement, head/body proportions, face placement and camera in all frames. Shallow three-quarter facing RIGHT when awake. Register center and bottom ground baseline consistently within every cell, with generous margins around all ears. Body wider than tall, long ears above. Animate gently through adjacent frames rather than drawing unrelated poses. Preserve volume and specific paper-tab shape. Subtle anticipation, overlap, squash/stretch and ear inertia; not rubber distortion. Keep unused parts identical. Every row is sixteen gradual drawings of ONE action; cyclical rows close seamlessly. Each character is fully separate with transparent gutters.
ROW1: relaxed breathing cycle with one natural short blink.
ROW2: curious scanning, ears swivel, face looks slightly up then forward.
ROW3: continuous RIGHT scooting/walking cycle, rolling body weight and trailing ears, no limbs.
ROW4: neutral to anticipatory crouch for takeoff.
ROW5: takeoff to rising jump, ears gradually trail down.
ROW6: falling, ears float upward, body prepares landing.
ROW7: landing compression, soft rebound, then neutral.
ROW8: first8frames gentle full-body stretch returning neutral; last8frames quick body/ear shake returning neutral.
ROW9: being picked up, softly squirming body and wiggling ears cycle.
ROW10: receiving affection, happy eyes and small joyful body wiggle cycle.
ROW11: gradually becoming sleepy and yawning, eyelids close.
ROW12: curled resting body sleeping/breathing cycle, both ears remain.
ROW13: sleepy to alert wake-up and tiny stretch.
ROW14: heart-tap intent, lean then little spring and pleased recovery, no drawn heart.
ROW15: shy peeking to hiding crouch, both ears progressively lower.
ROW16: reappearance from low crouch to alert and settled.
Consistent clean anti-aliased finish, genuine alpha transparency. Prioritize continuity and recognizable original identity in all256frames.
